method: Regular-time penalties were evaluated separately from shootouts.
A backup was not promoted solely because the filed primary was absent, injured or departed.
Current official events and direct hierarchy statements outweighed historical totals.
Official Ligue 1 Fantasy and Transfermarkt histories were supporting evidence rather than substitutes for current direct evidence.
X and Reddit leads were not used dispositively without corroboration from a higher-tier source.

verdict_definitions.KEEP: Retain the filed order because available evidence does not justify a change.
verdict_definitions.REVIEW: The filed primary remains plausible, but part of the current hierarchy is uncertain.
verdict_definitions.CHANGE_CANDIDATE: Evidence supports changing or vacating at least one material position.
verdict_definitions.UNRESOLVED: No current order can be recommended defensibly.

evidence.summary: Van den Boomen had a 51st-minute penalty saved before Koyalipou converted a separate 77th-minute penalty. The sequence does not establish a coexistence hierarchy because the two attempts occurred in different availability contexts.

evidence.title: FL1 : Les tireurs de pénaltys et de coups de pied arrêtés par club
evidence.summary: Recorded Koyalipou at 1/1, Sbaï at 0/1 and Van den Boomen at 0/1 after matchday 33.

evidence.title: Goduine Koyalipou joins KV Kortrijk

x.summary: Searches primarily returned official-club post mirrors, match updates and transfer discussion. No X-only hierarchy claim was used as dispositive evidence.

reddit.summary: Relevant clips and discussions were checked for events and squad leads. The Brest clip is retained as a corroborating community lead; no Reddit-only hierarchy claim determined a recommendation.

limitations: The audit was completed during preseason before the configured 2026/27 Ligue 1 start date.
No 2026/27 competitive Ligue 1 regular-time penalty had occurred at the audit date.
Current-preseason penalties were used only when the taker's availability context was clear.
A backup was not promoted solely because a filed player was absent, injured or had departed.
Shootout attempts were identified separately and excluded from regular-time hierarchy inference.
Transfer activity after 2026-07-27 may change unresolved or low-confidence orders.
